items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Holman has the most – he’s a hero of mine too, I just love Bill Holman’s writing

ctx.x: The interesting thing about Woody although he might not have liked linear things eventually got to like Bill Holman a lot.
Yeah well Bill Holman is the only guy who could write linear like that and have it swing madly. Bill was one of swingingest writers of all.

items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Apparently he brought Holman east to work in New York… That’s right; Bill was with us at the same time.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was it, and I was around New York at that time, so I went and rehearsed the band and all that stuff.
Apparently he brought Holman east to work in New York…
That’s right; Bill was with us at the same time.
